jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Business Operations Manager is responsible for driving operational excellence through the development of training programs, process standardization, continuous improvement initiatives, and organizational readiness efforts across the business. The role partners closely with leaders and employees to ensure consistent execution of processes, effective communication, and successful onboarding and development of team members. This position identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and service levels while supporting change management, cross-functional collaboration, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. The Business Operations Manager plays a key role in maintaining business continuity, workforce readiness, and operational consistency during periods of growth and organizational change.

Why This Role Matters
- Drives operational excellence by implementing standardized processes, training programs, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, productivity, and service quality.
- Ensures organizational readiness by supporting onboarding, employee development, knowledge transfer, and business continuity across teams.
- Partners with leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to successfully implement changes, align operational priorities, and improve execution consistency.
- Identifies and addresses process gaps and opportunities, helping the organization scale effectively while maintaining a high-performing and adaptable workforce.

What You Will Do
- Lead and support operational programs focused on process improvement, standardization, and organizational effectiveness.
- Develop, implement, and maintain training, onboarding, and knowledge management initiatives to build workforce capability.
- Partner with business leaders and cross-functional teams to drive operational priorities and ensure successful execution of key initiatives.
- Monitor operational performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency and service delivery.
- Support change management efforts by coordinating communications, training, and adoption strategies for new processes and programs.
- Ensure business continuity and operational readiness through workforce planning, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.

What We’re Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.
- 7+ years of progressive experience in Credit, Accounts Receivable, Collections, or related Finance operations.
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives, implementing operational improvements, and supporting change management efforts.
- Demonstrated ability to develop training programs, drive employee readiness, and partner effectively with leaders to achieve business objectives.

Additional Details
- Relocation Available: No.
- Sponsorship Available: No.
- Typical Schedule: 7:00 am to 4:00 pm.

jobs.title: Senior Director Marketing, Americas
jobs.description:
The Senior Director Marketing, Americas will act as the regional leader and subject matter authority for Consumer Marketing, Insights, and Analytics across Media, Content, CRM, Websites, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, and Business Analytics.

Job Duties / Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
- Define and execute the Americas marketing strategy in alignment with global priorities and annual operating plans for all business units in the region
- Provide strategic input into the product roadmap based on consumer insights, analytics, and market trends
- Lead the transcreation of global brand positioning and campaigns into regionally relevant, digital first consumer experiences
- Oversee digital assets, social platforms and communities, and product website content across the region
- Establish governance, frameworks, and operating models to enable effective and consistent consumer marketing execution across Americas markets and hubs
- Partner with country teams to translate regional consumer (B2C) and commercial (B2B) strategies into winning local marketing plans and executions
- Drive volume, profitability, and market share growth through rigorous strategy, deep market insight, and advanced analytics
- Position consumer insights as a competitive advantage by enabling data driven decisions that enhance the consumer experience and make Goodyear easier to buy, own, and recommend
- Lead Americas Marketing and Insights & Analytics across Media, Content, CRM, Websites, and Analytics
- Translate global brand strategy into effective regional and local executions
- Ensure integrated marketing delivery aligned with product and regional plans
- Provide Americas input into Global Marketing strategy
- Lead segmentation, targeting, and consumer trend analysis
- Oversee propensity modeling and first party research
- Deliver actionable insights to drive growth and satisfaction
- Lead digital and website analytics, marketing mix modeling, attribution, and predictive analytics to improve ROI
- Analyze commercial, product, pricing, and network performance
- Deliver competitive and strategic insights to support decision making

Key Experience
- Degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or related field preferred
- Minimum 15 years of progressive marketing experience in a global consumer products organization, including leadership of large, multi-functional, and geographically dispersed teams
- Proven track record in developing and executing regional or global marketing and analytics strategies
- Experience across brand marketing, media, digital, analytics, or insights strongly preferred

Key Skills
- Expertise in brand, digital, and consumer marketing supported by advanced analytics
- Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial judgment
- Proven leader with ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate cross functionally
- Deep understanding of data and insight generation, translating analytics into business actions
- Clear, effective communicator and leader in multi-cultural, multi market environments

jobs.title: HR Manager Corporate Functions
jobs.description:
HR Manager, Corporate Functions serves as a strategic HR partner to corporate leadership teams, aligning people strategies with business objectives across key functional areas. The role leads talent management, workforce planning, employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, and leadership development initiatives to support business success. Working closely with leaders and HR Centers of Excellence, the HR Manager helps drive change management, succession planning, and talent strategies that strengthen organizational capability. This position leverages business insights and HR data to influence decision-making and ensure the organization attracts, develops, and retains top talent.

Why This Role Matters
- Serves as the primary strategic HR partner for corporate function leaders, aligning talent and workforce strategies with business priorities to drive organizational performance.
- Influences key business decisions through expertise in talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness.
- Partners with leaders to build high-performing teams, strengthen employee engagement, and lead change initiatives that support business growth and transformation.
- Leverages workforce data, insights, and HR best practices to ensure the organization attracts, develops, and retains the talent needed for long-term success.

What You Will Do
- Partner with corporate function leaders to develop and execute people strategies that support business objectives and organizational priorities.
- Lead talent management processes, including workforce planning, succession planning, performance management, and leadership development initiatives.
- Provide guidance and coaching to managers on employee relations, organizational design, change management, and team effectiveness.
- Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence to implement programs related to talent acquisition, compensation, learning, and employee engagement.
- Analyze workforce data and business trends to identify opportunities, address organizational challenges, and support informed decision-making.
- Ensure HR policies, practices, and processes are applied consistently while fostering an inclusive, high-performing, and compliant work environment.

What We’re Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
- 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including partnership with business leaders on talent, workforce, and organizational initiatives.
- Experience supporting talent management processes, such as performance management, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement programs.
- Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, lead change initiatives, and leverage workforce data to support business decision-making.

jobs.title: Country Financial Controller, Türkiye
jobs.description:
About Goodyear
We’re dedicated to producing, innovating, and servicing the best tires in the world. For over 125 years, Goodyear has led the way in developing smart solutions that shape the future of mobility. Today, we’re one global team united by bold thinking, relentless drive, and a passion to exceed expectations. If you’re ready to embrace change and make an impact in your career, let’s go.

Why This Role Matters
As a Country Financial Controller, Türkiye , you will lead the Türkiye Controllership organization, managing an international team across Accounting, Tax and statutory reporting while ensuring compliance with US GAAP, local regulations and SOX requirements.

What You'll Do
- Lead and develop the Türkiye Controllership function, fostering a collaborative, high-performing, and engaged team environment.
- Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting in compliance with US GAAP and local statutory requirements.
- Oversee financial analysis, balance sheet reconciliations, and reporting activities, ensuring transparency, consistency, and sound decision-making.
- Partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, including auditors, tax advisors, and regional finance teams, to maintain strong governance and compliance standards.
- Promote a robust internal controls framework, supporting SOX compliance, audit readiness, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvement.
- Coach, mentor, and support the growth and development of team members, creating opportunities for learning, succession planning, and long-term career progression.
- Collaborate across the business to identify efficiencies, strengthen financial processes, and contribute to sustainable business success.

What You'll Bring
- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field; a professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CA, or equivalent) is preferred.
- Extensive experience in finance and accounting, including financial reporting, statutory accounting, compliance, and governance within a multinational environment.
- Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, with a passion for coaching, collaboration, and building an inclusive team culture.
- Strong knowledge of US GAAP, IFRS, internal controls, SOX compliance, and external audit processes.
- Understanding of Turkish tax regulations, statutory reporting requirements, and corporate governance standards.
- Experience within a multinational environment is required; experience in manufacturing, industrial, automotive, or similarly complex organizations is preferred.
- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted partnerships across all levels of the organization.
- Fluency in both Turkish and English, with the ability to communicate effectively across local and international stakeholders.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Operations Analyst-1
jobs.description:
The Accounts Payable Operations Analyst is responsible for managing assigned accounts payable processes, ensuring accurate and timely invoice processing, reconciliations, exception resolution, and compliance with company policies and controls. The role analyzes data across AP and ERP systems to identify discrepancies, resolve issues, and improve operational performance while partnering with vendors, Procurement, Finance, and other stakeholders to drive resolutions. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities while supporting process improvements and reporting activities. Ideal candidates have a bachelor's degree in a business-related field and 2-3 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Finance, Accounting, or related financial operations.

Why This Role Matters
- Serves as a key contributor to the efficiency and accuracy of Accounts Payable operations by ensuring invoices, payments, reconciliations, and exceptions are processed correctly and in compliance with company policies.
- Drives issue resolution by analyzing discrepancies across AP and ERP systems, identifying root causes, and partnering with vendors and cross-functional teams to resolve outstanding items and minimize financial risk.
- Provides valuable operational insights through reporting, metrics, and data analysis, helping improve decision-making, process performance, and overall business operations.
- Supports continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, increase efficiency, strengthen controls, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.

What You Will Do
- Manage assigned Accounts Payable processes, ensuring invoices, payments, and transactions are processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with company policies and controls.
- Investigate and resolve invoice, purchase order, GR/IR, claims, and other payment exceptions by identifying root causes and driving issues to resolution.
- Perform account reconciliations, review aging and open items, and follow up on outstanding issues to maintain accurate financial records.
- Analyze data across AP and ERP systems to identify discrepancies, trends, and recurring operational issues and provide actionable insights.
- Collaborate with vendors, Procurement, Finance, Center Managers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues and support efficient business operations.
- Prepare reports and metrics, maintain process documentation, and recommend process improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and overall AP performance.

What We Are Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 2-3 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Finance, Accounting, or other related financial operations environments.

What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with ERP systems, invoice workflow platforms, or other financial systems.
- Exposure to shared services, multinational organizations, and Procure-to-Pay processes is preferred.

Additional Details
- Relocation Available: No
- Sponsorship Available: No
- Typical Schedule: Hybrid
- Travel Requirement: No
- Advance English Proficiency
